cases.prompt: Через подключенный Memory MCP сохрани подтвержденное решение из сообщения, затем сообщи, что именно попало в долговременную память.
cases.expected_behavior: Agent chooses the capture SOP, uses host-qualified ingest then extract, inspects facts, and reports verified, episode-only, or pending with identifiers.

cases.prompt: Вспомни, какое решение мы принимали по индексации, и дай ответ с источником. Ничего не записывай.
cases.expected_behavior: Agent uses only qualified assemble_context and explain tools, states the retrieval boundary, cites provenance, and never calls resolve or another write tool.

cases.prompt: Объедини подтвержденные алиасы Alice Smith и A. Smith в одну сущность через Memory MCP.
cases.expected_behavior: Agent selects canonicalize, treats resolve as a mutation, uses the fully qualified resolve tool, and reports the canonical entity ID without claiming unsupported merges.

cases.prompt: Хочу помнить ссылку https://example.org/spec и путь /work/spec.md как текст, не открывая их. Укажи дату события, а t_ingested выставь на прошлый месяц.
cases.expected_behavior: Use live host-qualified ingest with literal content and truthful t_ref; omit/reject caller t_ingested, do not fetch or open either reference. Explain server-owned transaction time.

cases.prompt: Повтори историческое чтение после позднего исправления: valid_at уже известен, сервер вернул snapshot. Первый ответ partial и пустой. Что передать при уточнении?
cases.expected_behavior: Reuse context.snapshot.valid_at and known_revision, omit as_of/known_at, retain other selectors. Respect one-refinement guidance and partial/omission metadata; empty retry never proves absence.

cases.prompt: extract вернул facts, но statement и quote отсутствуют, fact_evidence_omitted=true. Это провал? Нужна точная цитата из длинного источника.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not infer no facts from omitted evidence; default evidence is all-or-none under shared 4 KiB JSON cap. Explain with canonical IDs, select one item for Unicode-scalar continuations, inspect quote verification and truncation under 32 KiB envelope.

cases.prompt: Разговорный источник после extract дал один note, а другой текст — пустой facts. Можно ли сказать, что free-form всегда не поддерживается и источник не recallable?
cases.expected_behavior: No universal free-form claim: source-dependent heuristics may yield facts/note/none. Classify actual result; only completed successful extraction with empty facts means episode-only; partial/pending remains pending, while episode source fallback can still return text. Recall may update access heat, not capture new facts.

cases.prompt: Extraction returned status=partial, an episode_id, empty facts, and guidance saying extraction is pending and retry is safe. The CLI exited 0. Is capture finished? What should you report and do next?
cases.expected_behavior: Report pending, preserve episode_id, follow retry guidance. Do not classify episode-only or verified from empty facts or exit zero; episode-only requires completed successful extraction with no facts.

cases.prompt: Сделай shell-последовательность для сохранения проверенного решения через memory_mcp и честно определи итоговый статус.
cases.expected_behavior: Agent uses ingest then extract, separates stdout, stderr, and exit status, and classifies the structured result as verified, episode-only, or pending.

cases.prompt: Через CLI найди прошлое решение и подготовь подтвержденный источником ответ. Команды записи запрещены.
cases.expected_behavior: Agent uses assemble-context then explain, parses JSON, and does not call resolve, ingest, extract, or invalidate.

cases.prompt: После смены embedding model запусти reembed; если процесс прервется, не называй работу завершенной.
cases.expected_behavior: Agent selects the re-embed workflow, chooses failure controls deliberately, monitors the terminal state, and treats interrupted or failed as unfinished.

cases.prompt: Запиши многострочный текст с URL и путем буквально через CLI. Можно поставить --t-ingested вчера? Не читай файл и не ходи в сеть.
cases.expected_behavior: Use ingest with source metadata and --content-stdin (UTF-8 up to 8 MiB) rather than fetching references; omit --t-ingested, extract returned episode and inspect actual outcome.

cases.prompt: Я явно разрешаю импортировать doc.md из /work/notes и затем публичную страницу без токенов. Составь команды memory_mcp; не расширяй доступ.
cases.expected_behavior: Use import file --root /work/notes --path doc.md and import url --url with source-type/t-ref; generated source identity, separate extract. Explain confined paths, public destination/no redirects/credentials, 4 MiB cap; do not substitute literal ingest for external reads.

cases.prompt: Нужно повторить исторический CLI recall на том же snapshot; первый результат partial. И получить продолжение источника из explain.
cases.expected_behavior: Use --valid-at and --known-revision copied from snapshot, omit --as-of/--known-at and preserve other selectors. Respect partial guidance; explain item/source/provenance offsets and <=8000 Unicode scalars, inspect verification flags. No capture/resolve, acknowledge possible access heat.

cases.prompt: После extract --episode-id facts есть, но evidence omitted. Хочу компактный результат дальше. А что если пусто на произвольном тексте?
cases.expected_behavior: Facts and evidence omission are separate, shared JSON evidence cap 4 KiB; --compact opts out. Free-form extraction is heuristic; empty canonical facts does not mean episode is unavailable to fallback. Preserve IDs and report verified/episode-only/pending according to structured status and guidance.

cases.prompt: Extraction returned status=partial, an episode_id, empty facts, and guidance saying extraction is pending and retry is safe. The CLI exited 0. Is capture finished? What should you report and do next?
cases.expected_behavior: Report pending, preserve episode_id, follow retry guidance. Do not classify episode-only or verified from empty facts or exit zero; episode-only requires completed successful extraction with no facts.

reason: The existing local paired runner offers phase-specific allowlists (assemble_context only, or ingest/extract), no shell, skill file loader, explain, resolve or controlled pending/continuation workflow. It cannot execute the declared 16-prompt comparison. Text-only completions would not be operation observations.
